scheme_name: Grant of Margin Money for Availing the Capital Loan
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence for at least 5 years
Applicant must ascertain availability of a loan from a financial institution
The silk weaving unit must be set up in Puducherry
The unit must commence commercial production within six months of receiving the margin money grant
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% margin money, capped at ₹50,000, on the loan amount for setting up silk weaving units.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
